title: "NextGen-Expert starts within FAIRagro"

**NextGen-Expert — Next-Generation Environmental and eXtended Tools for Extreme Events & Plant Resilience Assessment** started in October 2024 within [FAIRagro](https://fairagro.net/en/about-us/our-mission/), the community-driven initiative of the National Research Data Infrastructure (NFDI), funded by the Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft (DFG). The project runs until September 2026 and is coordinated by Dr. Amit Kumar Srivastava.
